description: This Java class 'JmsListenerFactory' manages JMS message listeners, including loading, refreshing, and closing listeners, and runs in a separate thread to initialize JMS listeners based on configuration.

classes.name: JmsListenerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for managing JMS listeners, implementing Runnable to run in a separate thread, with methods to load, refresh, close, and retrieve listeners.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern to get or create an instance of JmsListenerFactory.

methods.name: JmsListenerFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a Delegator and starts the thread.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main thread loop that loads listeners and waits, until all are connected or no more to load.

methods.name: loadListeners
methods.description: Loads JMS services and initializes listeners based on configuration.

methods.name: loadListener
methods.description: Loads a specific JMS listener based on server configuration, using reflection to instantiate listener classes.

methods.name: loadListener (overloaded)
methods.description: Loads a listener given a server key, retrieves server info, and calls the main loadListener method.

methods.name: closeListener
methods.description: Closes a specific JMS listener identified by server key.

methods.name: refreshListener
methods.description: Refreshes a specific JMS listener identified by server key.

methods.name: getJMSListeners
methods.description: Returns a map of current JMS listeners.
